# Ferrox Ecosystem Documentation

> High-performance, zero-overhead polyglot software ecosystem with 1,000,000 Req/Sec core engine and native Rust WebAssembly UI.

## Core Architecture & Runtimes
- [Ferrox Core](https://ferrox-rust.dev/core): High-performance Rust HTTP/WebSocket backend engine (1M RPS, BTreeMap routing, zero-copy linear memory).
- [Ferrox Front](https://ferrox-rust.dev/front): Native WebAssembly reactive UI library with Virtualized DataGrid (1M rows), SVG technical charts, and zero-JS reactivity.
- [Ferrox Node & Yalc](https://ferrox-rust.dev/node): Node.js & NestJS enterprise microservices layer with CQRS, event-driven sagas, and transport adapters.
- [Ferrox Python](https://ferrox-rust.dev/py): Asynchronous Python 3.12+ engine with authentication, commerce gateways, and data processing pipelines.
- [Ferrox Polyglot](https://ferrox-rust.dev/polyglot): Multi-runtime integrations for PHP 8.3+ (Saga/CQRS) and Java 21+ (Hexagonal DDD).
